style_dna.tone: professional, quietly confident, zero marketing warmth
signature_moves: Near-black canvas with a barely-lighter surface layer; separation comes from a 1px border, not a shadow
One saturated indigo accent against an otherwise fully neutral palette — color means 'act here'
Keyboard-first affordances rendered inline: every row shows its shortcut in a muted mono chip
Row-based lists instead of cards; each row is 32-40px tall with a single-line summary
Text hierarchy carried by weight and grey level, never by large size jumps
anti_patterns: Drop shadows or glassmorphism to separate surfaces
Multiple accent hues, gradient buttons, or colored section backgrounds
Generous card grids with 24px+ padding — the density collapses and it stops reading as this system

Button.style: solid primary; secondary is transparent with a 1px border
Button.states: hover lightens the fill one step; focus shows a 2px primary ring at 40% opacity
Button.notes: [inferred] Icon-only variant is a 32×32px square with the same radius.

Card.notes: Used sparingly; lists prefer rows over cards.

Input.style: 1px border, no inner shadow; placeholder in text_muted
Input.notes: Focus swaps the border to primary rather than adding a glow.

ListRow.style: borderless rows separated by a 1px divider; whole row is the hit target
ListRow.states: hover raises the background to surface; selected adds a 2px primary left bar
ListRow.notes: The core surface of the product — density lives or dies here.

Navigation.style: fixed left sidebar on background, sections separated by spacing not borders
Navigation.notes: Collapses to an icon rail under 1024px. [inferred]

Modal.style: surface_raised panel + overlay shadow over a 60% black scrim
Modal.notes: The command menu is the same shell at 640px wide.
